The '''Wyl sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] that bordered the [[Aparo sector/Legends|Aparo sector]], the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], and [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. During [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] rule, it was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Gozric]].
